Massachusetts Minutemen.status: Transfer — described as a possible starter rather than a confirmed one; a homecoming for a Massachusetts native.
Massachusetts Minutemen.career_experience: Never really given a chance to start; a three-star recruit and the MaxPreps High School Quarterback of the Year in Massachusetts in 2021.
Massachusetts Minutemen.passing: Not addressed in guide for Watson. Last season's quarterbacks collectively posted an 8-to-9 touchdown-to-interception ratio.
Massachusetts Minutemen.rushing: Not addressed in guide for Watson; the guide notes six different players, including two quarterbacks, had at least 40 rushing attempts last season.
Massachusetts Minutemen.turnovers: Nine interceptions against eight touchdowns from the quarterback group.
Massachusetts Minutemen.competition: Not settled — the guide calls Watson a possible starter heading what it describes as a much better room.
Massachusetts Minutemen.backup: Not addressed by name; the guide notes three different quarterbacks started last season.
Massachusetts Minutemen.author_confidence: Cautiously improved. The guide calls this a much better room while stating its wider hesitation is that it does not even know whether Harasymiak is a good coach.
Massachusetts Minutemen.positive_case: A three-star recruit and state high-school player of the year returning home, in a room the guide rates much better, with new coordinator Max Warner — previously an offensive assistant at Toledo — seen as an upgrade.
Massachusetts Minutemen.concerns: The baseline is dire: 3.9 yards per play with an 8-to-9 ratio, and last season's churn saw three different quarterbacks start.
Massachusetts Minutemen.scheme_fit: Mike Bajakian left to be the Cleveland Browns' quarterbacks coach; the guide's judgement is unsentimental — given the offense's numbers he is not really a big loss, and Warner seems like an upgrade.
Massachusetts Minutemen.supporting_cast: Improving through the portal. The guide counts quite a few Power Four transfers across this cycle and the staff's first. Last season Jacquon Gibson had 63 catches while nobody else had more than 27.
Massachusetts Minutemen.portal_context: Quite a few Power Four transfers across two cycles; Watson is the named quarterback addition.
Massachusetts Minutemen.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 2.5 wins. The guide reads the market as confident in three wins coming from Sacred Heart, Stonehill, Sacramento State, Eastern Michigan, Ball State and Akron, and says it cannot blame them: this team is absolutely better on paper and the schedule is absolutely friendlier. Projection is 2.77 wins.
Massachusetts Minutemen.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Over rests on the schedule and on FCS opponents rather than on quarterback play.

Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.status: Transfer — from Kansas; the guide's stated lean rather than a confirmed starter.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.career_experience: Not addressed in guide as a start count; the guide cites his recruiting offers as the evidence.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.passing: Not addressed in guide for McComb. Thomas Gotkowski, who finished last season as starter, completed only 44.2% of his passes.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.efficiency: Not addressed in guide for McComb; team-level, the offense completed under 50% of its passes.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.competition: Open. Gotkowski remains on the roster alongside McComb and Division II Fort Hays State transfer Caleb Heavner; the guide states a lean rather than an outcome.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.author_confidence: Moderate and comparative. The guide's lean is McComb, arguing he is probably a better fit because he is more Gabbert-like than Dequan Finn was.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.positive_case: Offers from Memphis, Virginia Tech, North Texas and Tulane among others, and a profile the guide judges closer to Brett Gabbert, the programme's all-time third-leading passer.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.concerns: The position was chaotic last season — Gabbert exhausted his eligibility, Finn quit the programme before facing his old team, Henry Hesson was awful against Toledo, and Gotkowski finished at 44.2% completions.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.scheme_fit: The guide's fit argument is stylistic: McComb is more Gabbert-like than Finn was.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.supporting_cast: A thunder-and-lightning ground game behind an offensive line that played together a lot last season. Rodney Nelson arrives from Fort Hays State after averaging better than six yards per carry, and D'Shawntae Jones returns — a 5-foot-10, nearly 250-pound back who averaged 4.4 yards on 63 attempts and led the team with seven rushing touchdowns. The benchmark the guide sets is 4.94 yards per carry against MAC opponents two seasons ago, against 4.1 last year.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.portal_context: McComb from Kansas, Heavner and Nelson from Fort Hays State.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 7.5 wins, with the MAC co-favourites expected to split non-conference. Miami misses Sacramento State and Eastern Michigan and gets UMass and Kent State on the road. The case rests on consistency: 21-6 in MAC play over the last three seasons with at least six wins each time, and with plus money available on eight or more wins the guide trusts Martin to do what he almost always does. Projection is 7.77 wins.
Miami (Ohio) RedHawks.outlook_dependency: Moderate. The guide's Over rests on programme consistency and Martin's record rather than on the quarterback resolution.

Ohio U Bobcats.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the guide names three options and expects all to fall short of the programme's bar.
Ohio U Bobcats.previous_school: Matt Vezza comes from New Hampshire; Nick Poulos and Levi Davis are in-house.
Ohio U Bobcats.career_experience: Nick Poulos redshirted last season; Matt Vezza ran for 600 yards at New Hampshire; Levi Davis is an incoming freshman, a three-star from the Columbus area.
Ohio U Bobcats.passing: Not addressed in guide for any candidate. Departing starter Parker Navarro posted a 27-to-22 touchdown-to-interception ratio across two seasons.
Ohio U Bobcats.rushing: Vezza ran for 600 yards at New Hampshire; Navarro had nearly 2,000 rushing yards with 27 rushing scores.
Ohio U Bobcats.efficiency: Team-level: 6.1 and 6.2 yards per play over the last two seasons, yet Ohio has not scored 30 PPG since 2022.
Ohio U Bobcats.turnovers: Navarro's 27-to-22 ratio across two seasons is the guide's reference point.
Ohio U Bobcats.competition: Open among returnee Nick Poulos, New Hampshire transfer Matt Vezza and incoming freshman Levi Davis, with the guide naming no favourite.
Ohio U Bobcats.backup: The three named candidates are Poulos, Vezza and Davis.
Ohio U Bobcats.author_confidence: Low relative to the standard. The guide's verdict is that the bar is set so high virtually any of them is likely to fall short.
Ohio U Bobcats.positive_case: Programme history. The guide describes a generational run at the position since Tyler Tettleton arrived in 2009, noting Ohio's three all-time leading passers all come from the last 20 years.
Ohio U Bobcats.concerns: None of the three has an FBS starting record, and the guide's specific scenario is a transitional year spent developing Davis to follow the line of productive predecessors.
Ohio U Bobcats.scheme_fit: Coordinator Scott Isphording is in place alongside first-year head coach John Hauser.
Ohio U Bobcats.supporting_cast: Almost nothing. One returning starter on offense, an offensive line featuring all new starters, and the loss of Sieh Bangura's 1,392 yards and 15 rushing touchdowns plus the top four receivers by yardage, including 1,000-yard pass-catcher Chase Hendricks. The guide says the offense looks unrecognisable this season.
Ohio U Bobcats.portal_context: A noticeably lacklustre portal class; Matt Vezza from New Hampshire is the named quarterback addition.
Ohio U Bobcats.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 6.5 wins. The guide states it is entirely possible an established, steady programme absorbs all of that, but says it has doubts. On the schedule Ohio avoids reigning champion Western Michigan but draws Miami and Toledo within a three-week stretch and must travel to Sacramento. Projection is 6.91 wins, with a down year seen as plausible.
Ohio U Bobcats.outlook_dependency: Very high. The quarterback is the first item on the guide's list of what Hauser inherits, and its transitional-year scenario is stated in quarterback-development terms.
Ohio U Bobcats.conflicts: The guide names three candidates and declines to state an expected starter, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Sacramento State Hornets.status: Transfer — returning to the programme from Fresno State, where he went when Brennan Marion took over.
Sacramento State Hornets.previous_school: Fresno State; started at Sacramento State in 2024.
Sacramento State Hornets.career_experience: Started at Sacramento State in 2024 before transferring to Fresno State.
Sacramento State Hornets.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count; the guide records he was the starter in 2024.
Sacramento State Hornets.competition: None described — Conklin is named as the returning quarterback.
Sacramento State Hornets.author_confidence: Neutral. Conklin's return is listed as evidence for competitiveness rather than assessed on his own merits.
Sacramento State Hornets.positive_case: He returns to the place where he was the starter in 2024, and 247Sports graded Sacramento State's portal class second in the MAC.
Sacramento State Hornets.concerns: Major questions in the trenches on both sides plus entirely new playbooks, with the very few returning offensive players facing a more traditional offense.
Sacramento State Hornets.scheme_fit: Discontinuous. Brennan Marion's up-tempo offense produced 33.8 PPG, but the scheme will be different this season under new coordinator Eric Kiesau, from Florida.
Sacramento State Hornets.supporting_cast: Depleted. The production being replaced is Rodney Hammond with over 1,200 rushing yards and Ernest Campbell with 755 yards on just 37 catches.
Sacramento State Hornets.portal_context: A great many new faces under new head coach Alonzo Carter; 247Sports graded the portal class second in the MAC.
Sacramento State Hornets.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins, with Mississippi Valley State and UMass identified as the best and perhaps only hopes for wins. Ohio, Kent State and Toledo all travel west in conference play. Its summary is that this is obviously a transitional year. Projection is 4.82 wins.
Sacramento State Hornets.outlook_dependency: Low. The guide's Under is argued from the FCS-to-FBS transition, travel and trench questions rather than from quarterback play.

Toledo Rockets.status: Undetermined — the guide's account of the roster names no quarterback among 37 transfers.
Toledo Rockets.passing: Not addressed in guide. The scheme benchmark it gives is Mercer's, where Jacobs' offense threw for over 3,800 yards.
Toledo Rockets.rushing: Not addressed in guide at quarterback.
Toledo Rockets.efficiency: Not addressed in guide at quarterback; Mercer racked up 6.8 yards per play last season under Jacobs.
Toledo Rockets.competition: Not addressed in guide — no candidates are named.
Toledo Rockets.author_confidence: Not expressed at the position; the guide's confidence is in the coaching hire.
Toledo Rockets.positive_case: Not addressed at quarterback. The guide's positive case is the scheme and the coach: Mercer under Jacobs posted 6.8 yards per play with a balanced approach that ranked third nationally in yards per game.
Toledo Rockets.concerns: Near-total turnover — the top returning tackler had 35 tackles and the top returnee in yards of any kind had 194 receiving yards.
Toledo Rockets.scheme_fit: Projected from Mercer: 4.9 yards per carry on more than 400 rushing attempts and over 3,800 passing yards, with the guide expecting a lean on the run at the outset.
Toledo Rockets.supporting_cast: Rebuilt around familiar players. The incoming group is heavy with Mercer transfers who followed Jacobs, including running back CJ Miller and receiver Adjatay Dabbs, plus offensive linemen familiar to coordinator Cris Reisert who came with him from Gardner-Webb, Penn State transfer Cory Smith and two senior tackles who played for Toledo last season.
Toledo Rockets.portal_context: 247Sports lists 37 transfers for Toledo, the third-best MAC class in its ranking; John Alan Richter is named as a returnee Rockets fans may recognise.
Toledo Rockets.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 7.5 wins, resting first on a soft Year 1 schedule: Toledo misses Miami of Ohio, hosts reigning champion Western Michigan, and gets a visit from San Diego State. Its conclusion is that Jacobs seems like a good hire, with at least some familiarity thanks to transfers from a team that finished in the FCS Top 25 in each of the last two seasons. Projection is 8.04 wins.
Toledo Rockets.outlook_dependency: Low as stated. The guide's Over is argued from the coaching hire, the scheme and the schedule; it does not name a quarterback at all.
Toledo Rockets.conflicts: The guide names no quarterback for Toledo anywhere in the spread, so this record carries no VSiN preseason expectation for the position.

Western Michigan Broncos.status: Returning starter — the conference's reigning Offensive Player of the Year.
Western Michigan Broncos.career_experience: Took the job full-time after a timeshare with Brady Jones to start last year, and won conference Offensive Player of the Year.
Western Michigan Broncos.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count.
Western Michigan Broncos.passing: 1,803 passing yards as part of 23 total touchdowns.
Western Michigan Broncos.rushing: 963 rushing yards on 203 carries; the guide identifies his running as the separator for the offense and for him personally.
Western Michigan Broncos.efficiency: Team-level: 109th in yards per play at 5.2, which the guide explains as a function of run-pass distribution with over 600 rushing attempts — seventh nationally in total rush attempts.
Western Michigan Broncos.turnovers: Not addressed in guide individually; Western Michigan had a +9 turnover margin.
Western Michigan Broncos.competition: None described — Lowry is the settled starter.
Western Michigan Broncos.backup: Brady Jones shared the job at the start of last season; the guide states there is not much depth behind Lowry.
Western Michigan Broncos.author_confidence: High on the player, cautious about sustainability. The guide calls returning the conference's Offensive Player of the Year at quarterback rare, then warns staying on top could be harder than it looks.
Western Michigan Broncos.positive_case: A dual-threat conference Offensive Player of the Year returning alongside a 1,000-yard running back, behind a pretty experienced offensive line — the foundation the guide says makes something special possible.
Western Michigan Broncos.concerns: A specific durability worry — there is a great deal of depth behind Buckley but not behind Lowry, who had 203 carries, a lot for a 6-foot-1 quarterback — and an open question about whether Western Michigan can pass enough to keep defenses honest.
Western Michigan Broncos.scheme_fit: Established. The guide describes something of a throwback under coordinator Walt Bell, running double tight ends, and says it worked, with Western Michigan playing keep-away at 4.6 yards per carry.
Western Michigan Broncos.supporting_cast: Strong. Jalen Buckley shook off an injury-plagued 2024 to average 5.6 yards per carry, behind a pretty experienced offensive line, with the portal used for depth rather than impact on offense.
Western Michigan Broncos.portal_context: The guide names the asymmetry directly: using the portal for depth rather than impact is a luxury, and that is the case on offense, but the defense is a major work in progress.
Western Michigan Broncos.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 7.5 wins. The schedule hardens with no UMass or Ball State and Michigan, Rice and Boise State in non-conference, and the guide works through the Rice game in detail — a running-clock game between teams averaging 49.8 and 44.5 rushing attempts, so the margin for error could be thin. Projection is 7.39 wins.
Western Michigan Broncos.outlook_dependency: Very high, and specifically on availability. The guide's stated durability concern about Lowry's carry count sits alongside the defensive rebuild as the reasons for the Under.
